shops.title: You rent out equipment? Your tools can live here too.
shops.lede: RentIt is a tool showcase in Walloon Brabant. A customer picks a tool and dates, you accept or decline, and you arrange the rest directly. Nothing more — and nothing else.
shops.have1: Your listings online immediately, at no cost.
shops.have2: Customers pick their dates; dates already taken are no longer offered.
shops.have3: Requests arrive in your dashboard; you accept or decline.
shops.have4: Contact details are exchanged only once a booking is accepted.
shops.notLede: Said upfront rather than after: these limits are part of the offer, not the small print.
shops.not1: No money passes through RentIt. Settlement is in cash, between you and the customer.
shops.not2: No insurance, no deposit held by the platform. RentIt is not a party to the contract.
shops.not3: No commission today. If paid options ever arrive, they will be announced, not slipped in.
shops.not4: No traffic promised. A listing is visible; it does not sell itself.
shops.stateBody: The showcase is new and empty: the demo listings were removed, because an invented catalogue tells you nothing true. We are looking for the first rental businesses in Walloon Brabant. Being first means little competition and a listening ear — not a queue of customers.

landing.lede: List a tool: your ad goes live immediately, free of charge. A neighbour gets in touch, you decide, you are paid in person.
landing.zeroBody: RentIt is just starting in Walloon Brabant, and we are not pretending otherwise. Yours would be the first one neighbours see.
landing.photoAlt: An old wooden toolbox with a chisel and a drawknife laid in front of it.
landing.photoCaption: Illustration — the tools in the listings belong to your neighbours.
landing.stepsTitle: You stay in charge, at every step.
landing.step1Body: Photos, price per day, the dates the tool is free. Five minutes, no fee.
landing.step2Body: You get the request and you decide. Their number reaches you only after you agree — and yours reaches them.
landing.step3Body: Photos of its condition at handover and return, visible to both of you. You settle up between yourselves, in cash.
landing.limitsLede: Said here, not in small print: a limit known in advance costs less than a nasty surprise.
landing.limit1Title: RentIt does not touch the money.
landing.limit1Body: You agree the price, you are paid in person. Nothing passes through the platform.
landing.limit2Body: The platform is not party to the agreement and covers no damage. Check whether your home liability insurance applies.
landing.limit3Body: Today it is free. Paid options may come later, announced in advance — never switched on without your agreement.
landing.catsTitle: Does your tool fall into one of these six categories?
landing.renterLabel: Looking to borrow, not to lend?
landing.renterTitle: There is nothing listed today — we are not hiding it.
landing.renterBody: Have a look anyway, or come back once a neighbour has listed the first tool.
landing.finalTitle: The first tool in Walloon Brabant is not online yet.
landing.finalBody: Five minutes, free, and every request stays your call.
